name: KAYTHEBOSS
description: KAYTHEBOSS is a graphic design studio in Berlin and New York. We design packaging, logos and websites that people notice — and that make your business easier to choose.

disciplines.title: Packaging & Labels
disciplines.body: Packaging that stands out on a busy shelf and feels worth the price in your hand.
points: Looks that catch the eye in-store
Boxes and bottles that fit properly

disciplines.title: Visual Identity Design
disciplines.body: A logo and a look that people recognise, plus simple rules so your team can use it correctly.

disciplines.title: Websites & Apps
disciplines.body: Websites and app screens that load quickly, are easy to use, and look the way you intended.
points: Design that works on every screen size
